findings.message: This HTML file has 11 timed elements. Smaller sub-compositions keep timelines easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Move coherent scene groups into separate .html files under compositions/ and mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so the timeline stays easier to inspect, revise, and validate.

findings.message: Font families used without @font-face declaration: pingfang sc, microsoft yahei, noto sans sc. These are not in the auto-resolved font list, so the renderer cannot supply them automatically. Text will fall back to a generic font, producing incorrect typography in the video.
findings.fixHint: Add @font-face { font-family: '...'; src: url('capture/assets/fonts/...woff2'); } for each font family, pointing to the captured .woff2 files, or switch to a Google Fonts family. An OS font such as PingFang SC or Hiragino Sans renders locally from the installed copy, but a cloud render has no copy and refuses it.
